author: Johannes Franz Lang (frcola), with coding-agent and image-generation assistance
originalRequest:
Create an ORIGINAL TRANSPARENT GAME ASSET SHEET matching the attached approved pirate-village concept's extremely polished richly shaded stylized 3D art. This is production vegetation artwork for a three-quarter orthographic strategy game, not a scene or UI. Use real transparent alpha background everywhere outside the objects and their very soft contact shadows. No checkerboard, no white mat, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no ocean or ground platform.

The sheet is a precise axis-aligned FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, landscape 1536x1024. Each of its eight equal cells is 384x512 pixels. Leave a safe empty transparent gutter of at least32pixels inside every cell; nothing touches an adjacent cell. Every object is centered horizontally in its cell, standing on the same local ground baseline near y470 of its cell. Top-row cells hold four trees; bottom-row cells hold four smaller nature assets. Keep every entire silhouette and contact shadow fully inside its own cell. Render each asset separately on transparency, never connected into a landscape.

TOP ROW, LEFT TO RIGHT:
1. A lush broadleaf island OAK: thick warm-brown slightly branching trunk, voluminous rounded clusters of layered emerald/lime leaves with many individually shaped leaf tufts, dappled warm sunlight, a few subtle reddish berries. Not a flat cloud shape. Main roots stand on baseline.
2. A full evergreen PINE: layered rounded tapering boughs, richly shaded dark teal-green needles, believable trunk visible at base, strong dimensional silhouettes. No ornaments or snow.
3. A medium curved PALM: gently bending ringed tan trunk, broad sweeping feathered fronds and a few coconuts, bright sunny leaves and deep self-shadow. Whole trunk rooted at baseline.
4. A taller slimmer PALM variant: distinct taller curved trunk and elevated spreading frond crown, same polished material family and ground baseline.

BOTTOM ROW, LEFT TO RIGHT:
5. A small cluster of FACETED WARM-GRAY ROCKS: one main tan-gray stone and two smaller stones, many soft beveled planes with convincing three-dimensional shading and warm highlights. Place low in the cell on the baseline, not floating.
6. A lush rounded GREEN SHRUB: layered richly shaded leaves with a few tiny golden flowers. Low bush on baseline, no surrounding grass patch.
7. A small FLOWER CLUMP: a handful of pink, yellow and white tropical wildflowers with individually modeled petals, green stems/leaves, natural uneven heights and shadow. No flowerpot.
8. A small GRASS TUFT: several curved broad tropical grass blades, fine dimensional highlights and dark leafy core, well-separated tapered tips. No flat rectangular lawn tile.

Visual style is the attached reference's high-quality miniature strategy-game rendering: rounded beveled forms, hand-painted realistic material details, warm sunlight from upper left, subtle ambient occlusion in leaf clusters, softly shaded right/front faces, crisp clean alpha edges, no thick black outline. Tree objects should occupy roughly70–82% of cell height; the rock/shrub/flower/grass objects should remain appropriately smaller but high-resolution. All eight use the exact same camera, sun direction and color harmony. The reference's vegetation richness is the target. Do not reproduce buildings or interface. Deliver exactly one transparent sheet with all eight separate assets in the specified4×2 order.
layoutCorrectionRequest:
Refine this transparent vegetation asset sheet for production use. Preserve the beautiful shaded3D foliage, bark, rocks and plants EXACTLY in the same original design/material style. Keep real transparent alpha and no text or visible grid.

Correct only asset placement and containment:
- Canvas remains1536×1024, precisely4columns×2rows, eachcell384×512.
- Top row is oak,pine,palm,tall palm, in that order. Each complete tree/crown/root/contactshadow must fit inside its own cell with at least28 transparent pixels on every side. The oak must no longer touch/crop at the left edge, and the tall palm must no longer touch the right edge. Reconstruct any formerly clipped leaves.
- Center EACH TREE'S TRUNK ROOT FOOT horizontally at localx192, and set its ground root baseline at localy470. Thus the root feet are at canvas(192,470),(576,470),(960,470),(1344,470). A palm's canopy may overhang asymmetrically inside the safe cell but its root foot stays centered.
- Bottom row is rock cluster,shrub,flowers,grass tuft. Center each object's ground-contact foot at localx192,localy470 within its bottom-row cell: canvas(192,982),(576,982),(960,982),(1344,982). Keep each whole object and soft contact shadow inside its384×512cell with28px side gutters. Lower plants are intentionally much shorter than trees.
- NO tree pixels may extend below y500 or into the lower row. NO asset may cross a column boundary. Empty space between cells is fully transparent.
Use rich warm upper-left light, green/yellow foliage, soft realistic miniature volume and no thick outline. Maintain the true alpha cutout; all colored/background pixels outside the eight separate objects must have zero alpha. Do not add any scenery, ground tile, color field, vignette, checkerboard, borders or labels. Output one refined transparent sheet.
alphaCorrectionRequest:
Perform BACKGROUND REMOVAL ONLY on this production vegetation asset sheet. Keep the canvas1536×1024, keep all eight objects at exactly their present positions and sizes, keep their colors/design/details and root contact points. Do not rearrange, enlarge or redraw the objects.

The PNG must have a genuinely clear transparent background with ALPHA EXACTLY ZERO throughout the empty margins, gutters and all four corner pixels. Remove every colored blurred ambient/background glow, color field and almost-transparent matte left around the objects. Retain clean smooth antialiased edges of the actual leaves/trunks/rocks/plants and only a small restrained local contact shadow directly below each object. Transparent pixels may have any RGB but MUST have alpha0 outside the objects/shadow. Do not add a checkerboard, solid matte, vignette, labels, frame or scenery. All four extreme canvas corner pixels must be completely transparent, alpha0. Preserve the nature artwork and precise source layout. Output one real transparent RGBA PNG.
note: The final image is copied byte-for-byte. Source rectangles describe its actual nonuniform layout. No offline crop or pixel edits were performed. The first corrected export had alpha1 in a corner; image_gen background removal fixed the asset while preserving the original strict corner test. Runtime visual acceptance is separate.
